## What this changes

<!-- One change per pull request, into the next version's branch (1.1, say) - master is the
latest release. Link the issue it closes: "Closes #12". -->

## Checked

- [ ] A bug fix, a translation or docs - or a feature agreed in a Discussion first
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` and `python -m ruff check .` pass, with a test for the new behaviour or the bug
- [ ] Looked at it in a browser: light and dark theme, a phone width and a wide screen (if it touches the UI)
- [ ] A line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md (if a user would notice)
- [ ] The user guide describes it (if it's a feature)
- [ ] Commit messages say what changed and why, with no personal details (CLAUDE.md > Commit messages)
- [ ] I've read the whole change myself, including any part an AI assistant wrote

<!-- The conventions are in CLAUDE.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md. -->
